label: PF Backlog 508
title: E2: config/review-focus.json - committed, validated production-risk checklist the agent consumes (single source, in sync)
body:
## Problem / why
Review criteria live only in prose; they should be a committed, validated checklist so they stay in sync and are
testable.

## Acceptance criteria
config/review-focus.json lists the checklist (categories + what to check + severity policy); the code-review card
consumes it; a validator ensures categories/severity keys are well-formed; wired like the artifact map (gate).

## Out of scope
Per-project custom checklists (later).
